subject: Approval: Staggered onboarding & early-exit safeguards — Cerulean Health pilot
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot terms: request for flexible exit and staggered onboarding

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Cerulean is excited to try Redwood for a clinician-facing summarization pilot. Before we spin up the pilot, legal has asked that we confirm a couple of non-standard contract items so procurement can move quickly: 

1) Staggered onboarding: we propose a 6-month pilot that starts small (10 clinician seats) and scales monthly (+10 seats/month) to a 60-seat run rate. We want that ramp schedule in the SOW so internal teams can plan.

2) Early-exit / downsell protection: if the product materially misses the use-case after initial evaluation (~60 days), we need a defined opt-out path that enables us to reduce committed capacity without a full termination fee. Suggested: a 60-day opt-out with prorated credit toward remaining months.

3) Security holdbacks: Cerulean requires SOC2 in place and a short audit window before going to production.

I've attached the SOW draft. If Redwood is open to a conservative opt-out and a staggered ramp schedule, procurement can greenlight the pilot quickly — otherwise we risk pushing the start date.

Attachment: Cerulean_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF)

Would appreciate if you could escalate to deal desk + legal and loop back with the recommended guardrails.

Best,
Priya
Priya Singh
Director, Product Operations
Cerulean Health
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@ceruleanhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot terms: request for flexible exit and staggered onboarding

Hi Priya — thanks, and great to hear the team is ready.

I'll do two things: 1) escalate the opt-out/downsell ask to Deal Desk + Legal, and 2) propose an initial set of guardrails to keep risk bounded while we make the pilot attractive to Cerulean. Quick summary of our suggested approach (internal):

- Staggered onboarding: include the proposed ramp schedule in the SOW (10 -> +10/month until 60 seats).
- Pilot designation: label this engagement explicitly as a "Pilot" in both SOW and billing (different handoffs/credits apply).
- Opt-out window: consider a 60–90 day early-exit window for the pilot with prorated credit on pre-paid months; cap total credit to limit downside.
- Downsell protection: if Cerulean reduces committed seats after the ramp, allow graduated reduction (e.g., 50% of previous month) with 30 days' notice.
- Security: legal must confirm SOC2/controls before production cutover; pilot can begin under tighter data controls.

Rishi — can you draft proposed contract language and an upper bound on credit exposure? Laura — I’ll need you to model expected MRR impact for the first 6 months so Deal Desk can evaluate.

I’ll keep Priya updated once we have a recommended approach.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot terms: request for flexible exit and staggered onboarding — legal review needed

Marissa — forwarding Cerulean's request for an early-exit / staggered ramp concession. Summary + analysis below.

On Mon, Mar 1, 2027 at 10:11 AM Priya Singh <priya@ceruleanhealth.com> wrote:
> [original SOW attached]

Summary of ask:
- Pilot with a ramp to 60 seats over 6 months; opt-out after ~60 days with prorated credit; security precondition (SOC2).

Legal assessment and recommended guardrails:
1) Opt-out window: recommend we allow a one-time pilot opt-out within 90 days of go-live, provided Cerulean gives 30 days' notice. This limits churn risk and gives time to decommission infra.
2) Credit cap: cap cumulative credits for early termination/downsell to the lesser of (a) 25% of contracted pilot value, or (b) $15,000 — whichever is lower. That keeps exposure finite for smaller pilots.
3) Ramp enforcement: ensure SOW contains monthly ramp checkpoints; non-delivery of seats does not automatically trigger credits unless Cerulean provides written notice.
4) Security clause: require SOC2 Type II in place for production cutover; allow pilot before SOC2 under an "evaluation" data handling addendum with stricter retention/PII rules.
5) No SLA exceptions: do not grant uptime SLA reductions or custom audit windows beyond standard enterprise terms.

If you approve the above approach, I'll attach a short redline for the termination clause and a draft SOW amendment for Alex to share externally. 

Attachment: proposed_termination_clause.docx

—Rishi
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot terms — approval for limited pilot concession

Team — I reviewed Rishi's recommendation and the business case from Alex. I approve a one-time, limited concession for Cerulean on the following explicit terms: 

1) Opt-out window: allow a one-time pilot opt-out within 90 days of go-live with 30 days' written notice.
2) Credit cap: cumulative credits for early termination or downsell are capped at the lower of $15,000 or 20% of the total contracted pilot value.
3) Pilot designation: the engagement must be labeled "Pilot" in contract and billing and excluded from annual committed-ARR calculations.
4) Ramp schedule: include the proposed month-by-month seat ramp in the SOW. Non-delivery of seats by Cerulean does not trigger credits unless they submit written notice and we validate attempted onboarding.
5) Security & procurement sign-off: SOC2 Type II must be present before production cutover; pilot may run under an evaluation addendum with strict data retention and logging. Procurement must confirm billing/coding prior to order activation.
6) One-time concession only: this approval applies only to DEAL-2027-014 and cannot be replicated without further exec review.

Please ensure the redline is limited to the termination and pilot-addendum language; do not amend the broader commercial terms. Laura — once Alex shares the final redline externally, update HubSpot and mark the deal record with this executive concession. Rishi — please circulate the redline and SOW amendment to Alex for signature-ready copy.

Approved —
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@ceruleanhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Pilot terms approved (next steps & DocuSign)

Hi Priya — good news: Redwood can accommodate the staggered onboarding and a limited early-exit concession for the pilot. Executive approval is in place with the following conditions (summary):

- One-time opt-out allowed within 90 days of go-live with 30 days' written notice.
- Credits for early termination/downsell capped at the lower of $15,000 or 20% of the pilot value.
- Engagement must be labeled a "Pilot" and excluded from committed ARR calculations.
- SOC2 Type II required before production cutover; pilot may begin under an evaluation addendum with tighter data controls.
- Ramp schedule included in SOW; credits only triggered following written notice and validation.

Rishi attached the redline and SOW amendment for your review. If that looks good, I'll route the package for signature (DocuSign) and Laura will get billing set up.

Attachments: redline_cerulean_contract.pdf, proposed_termination_clause.docx

Next steps: 1) review redline, 2) confirm go-live date window, 3) sign SOW. Can we aim to have the signed SOW by end of next week?

Thanks — excited to get the pilot running.
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
